text: When a user logs into Teamcenter from within SOLIDWORKS®, the above folder structure will be replicated under his SOLIDWORKS® cache directory, and the template files will be copied from Teamcenter into the replicated folders. His SOLIDWORKS® File Locations—Document Templates option will be adjusted to include the Teamcenter managed locations: SolidWorks Templates inpart inassembly Figure 27 - Teamcenter managed templates
